description: This file defines the Dependent class within the OrangeHRM core reporting system, specifically for dependent display fields in reports. It extends ListableDisplayField and provides methods to retrieve DTO class name, entity aliases, and relevant report fields.

classes.name: Dependent
classes.description: Represents a display field for dependents in HR reports, extending the ListableDisplayField to provide specific data such as DTO class, entity aliases, and field identifiers.

methods.name: getDtoClass
methods.description: Returns the class name of the DTO used for dependents in reports.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns an array of entity aliases related to dependents, used in report queries.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Returns the list of database fields associated with dependents, such as employee number.
